text:
ivy: heads-up: onboarding run for 'sablev2-int4' shows structured-output parse spikes only in streaming. Non-streaming clean.
omar: saw it too, ~0.7% parse_fail streaming vs 0.02% non-streaming. looks tied to multi-byte emoji + variation selectors across chunk boundaries.
kelly: minimal repro from captured chunks:
chunkA: '{"op":"tag","label":"Ava\ud83d'
chunkB: '\udc69‍❤️"}'
json fails because decoder inserted replacement char in middle.
ivy: hypothesis: assembling bytes then decoding is introducing U+FFFD when a codepoint is split. use incremental utf-8 decoder to avoid replacement: codecs.getincrementaldecoder('utf-8')().decode(bytes, final=False)
omar: agree. also add a tiny repair: on parse fail, try join+encode('utf-8','replace').decode('utf-8') then strip isolated U+FFFD and retry; if still fails, replay non-streaming.
kelly: need to preserve emojis; only strip if U+FFFD present and surrounding bytes indicate split. log first_8_hex and decoder_pending_bytes for triage.
stream-bot: canary: 4k calls, parse_fail=29, streaming_only=true, profile=int4.
ivy: mitigation in runtime: (1) incremental decoder for streaming assembly, (2) on parse error, attempt local repair+retry, (3) if repair succeeds, continue; else do single non-streaming replay with X-Redwood-Tool-Idempotency header.
omar: add token id neighborhood capture (5 tokens before/after) on parse_fail to check tokenizer split correlation.
kelly: tests: unit for incremental decoder and integration canary injecting emoji+vs16 sequences. nightly canary should monitor quant_profile tags.
ivy: I'll open PR with incremental decoder wrapper, repair logic, metrics tagging, and tests. assigning to me.
omar: I'll wire token neighborhood telemetry and add an alert if parse_fail_delta > 0.2% over baseline.
kelly: small caveat: replaying non-streaming can increase cost and latency; ensure retry budget respected. add X-Redwood-Retry-Budget header.
ivy: noted. action items recap: PR (ivy), telemetry (omar), retry-budget header (kelly), canary run (stream-bot).
ivy: will post PR link when ready. :thumbsup:
